decision_rule.positive_next_action: freeze the selected adapted strategy and complete match decisions before implementing whole-graph execution and the 23-pair production contract

match_and_execution_policy.selection: greedily accept a match only when none of its nodes was selected earlier in the strategy

match_and_execution_policy.within_phase_order: ascending tuple of graph node names

objective.positive_requires: candidate coverage and eligible artifacts equal baseline, candidate direct applications strictly lower than baseline, and candidate order differs from baseline

repository_policy.admission: exactly one canonical record per complete permutation
repository_policy.best: the single strategy selected by the frozen objective and tie break
repository_policy.eviction: none during this bounded complete enumeration
repository_policy.promising: the lexicographically first strategy for each distinct aggregate score vector

tool_grammar.candidate_strategy_space: every permutation of all eight tool names
tool_grammar.source: the exact eight tools in ATEN_FIXED_PORTFOLIO_V2.json
tool_grammar.strategy_representation: eight named one-iteration phases in an ordered EqSatL sequence
